description:
First release of **Reddit NSFW Blocker**, a patch bundle that blocks NSFW content in the Reddit app.

### ✨ New patch: Block NSFW content

- Hides NSFW posts from all feeds (home, popular, communities and profiles).
- Always turns off **Show mature content (I'm over 18)**. If the Reddit account has it turned on, the patch turns it off on the account once, so it is also off on the Reddit website and on other devices.
- Always turns on safe search and NSFW image blurring.
- Removes the **Show mature content** and **Blur NSFW images** options from settings (logged in, logged out and incognito mode) and from the incognito mode exit dialog.
- Cannot be turned off from inside the app.

### 📱 Supported versions

- Reddit `2026.39.0`

### 📦 How to use

Add `https://github.com/warleysr/reddit-nsfw-blocker` as a patch source in Morphe Manager, then patch Reddit with **Block NSFW content** together with the official Morphe Reddit patches.

---

Based on [Morphe Patches](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches) (GPLv3). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Morphe or Reddit.
